messages:
michelle_fin: Heads up - reconciliation flagged ~58 Stripe invoice.line_item mismatches during nightly reconcile (2024-09-02). NetSuite import rejected many because item_code was truncated to 20 chars by our transform. net-sync-bot: ns-import-20240902 job failed: NS_ERR_FIELD_TOO_LONG for item_code 'promo_super_long_code_2024_v1' (original length 28, NS limit 20). See logs /var/logs/netsync/ns-import-20240902.log.

dave_eng: Interesting — we added a safe-truncate step in the invoice-transform service in July to normalize free-form codes. Looks like we didn't preserve an internal mapping table, so different truncated strings collide. That explains the mismatches.

michelle_fin: Business impact: 58 invoice lines were skipped -> creates unreconciled differences totaling ~$4.9k. Some customers already charged in Stripe but NetSuite has no matching line item. Accounting can't close daily books.

harry_accounting: Can we backfill by matching on invoice_id and amount? We must avoid creating duplicate revenue lines. Prefer preserving original external_code as metadata.

dave_eng: Plan: 1) stop deploy that introduced truncation (rollback), 2) add a hashed-suffix when we must shorten (so truncated codes remain unique), 3) include original_code metadata in the NetSuite payload (custom field). I'll pick up 1 & 2. ETA 4h for rollback + fix.

ops_bot: rollback scheduled: revert invoice-transform v2 -> v1 at 2024-09-02T14:00 UTC. Will monitor.

dave_eng: Also writing backfill tool: reconcile_by_invoice -> for each skipped line, try match by (invoice_id, amount, tax). If unique match found, re-emit with full original_code (from Stripe metadata) to NetSuite. If multiple candidates, flag for manual review.

michelle_fin: Good. Please surface manual review list to billing@redwood. We need approvals before any changes.

net-sync-bot: backfill run ns-import-20240902-backfill started: processing 58 lines.

net-sync-bot: backfill progress: 58 processed -> 46 auto-matched and posted, 12 flagged manual review (ambiguous matches). See sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/finance/ns-mismatch-20240902.

harry_accounting: I'll review the 12 flagged items. For any that were already billed in Stripe, we will create corresponding NetSuite credit memos manually if needed.

michelle_fin: Also want a preventative alert: if >5 lines skipped for same reason (field too long or mapping miss) in a single import, page on-call billing.

dave_eng: Adding alert and unit tests for invoice-transform edge cases. Also will add a migration to copy original_code into custom field so future imports can be idempotent.

ops_bot: rollback completed and transform v1 restored. No further failures in immediate re-run.

michelle_fin: Thanks. Once backfill manual review is done, I'll reconcile books and notify FP&A. Please include a short incident note for monthly close.

dave_eng: Will follow up with PR for hashed truncation + metadata field.

michelle_fin: Appreciated. :thumbsup:
